health.title: Drink Water
health.text: Drink a glass of water when you wake up. It helps your body start the day.

advice.text: Take a short walk every day. Your heart will thank you.

story.title: A New Friend
story.body: Mary moved to a new town. She felt lonely at first. One day, she said hello to a neighbor. Now they walk together every morning. Small hellos can grow into big friendships.
